title: Know whether a Plan is still what we intend to do
statement: As a product manager, I can mark a Plan shipped or abandoned, so that nobody mistakes a finished or dropped Plan for what the team intends to do now.

acceptance_criteria.statement: An author can mark a Plan shipped, naming the Reviews that delivered it, and its page says so and links to them.
An author can mark a Plan abandoned only by giving a reason, and its page shows that reason.
A closed Plan no longer appears among open Plans, and it refuses new decisions and new slides, as a merged review does.
Closing a Plan changes no story's lifecycle state and no feature's Roadmap status; those remain separate decisions.
